brand_dna.category: UK wholesale supplier of commercial catering equipment and restaurant supplies - tableware, cookware, refrigeration, pizza and Asian specialist kit.
brand_dna.core_belief: Wholesale kitchenware should be simple and honest: 'we just provide good, honest restaurant supplies at low prices, making it easier for businesses to stock their kitchens.'
proof_points: Founded in 2017, serving restaurants and commercial kitchens across the UK and Europe
Free next working day delivery on UK mainland orders over £54 inc VAT, most orders dispatched same day if placed before 1pm
30 day returns accepted; rated 4.7/5 based on 302 reviews
Stocks recognised brands including KitchenAid, Cambro and Thunder Group, plus specialist pizza and Asianware ranges
brand_dna.positioning: Value-led wholesale with a personal touch - low bulk prices plus a tailored, human service, not a faceless supplier.

voice_pillars.name: Plain and Honest
voice_pillars.desc: Straight-talking, no hype - they state what they do and back it with price and service.
voice_pillars.quote: You won't find us making unnecessary sales pitches

voice_pillars.name: Value-First
voice_pillars.desc: Price is front and centre, framed as helping businesses stock up without overspending.

voice_pillars.name: Personal and Tailored
voice_pillars.desc: They lean on a dedicated, one-to-one service rather than a transactional wholesale experience.
voice_pillars.quote: a personalised service just for you

voice_pillars.name: Fast and Practical
voice_pillars.desc: Speed of supply and ease of ordering are treated as core benefits for busy kitchens.
voice_pillars.quote: Easy high-volume ordering and repeat ordering

phrases: good, honest restaurant supplies at low prices
a simple, straightforward solution to their kitchenware needs
Easy high-volume ordering and repeat ordering
a personalised service just for you

icp: UK and European foodservice operators - restaurants, pubs, cafes, hotels, schools and care homes - who need to stock or restock commercial kitchens in bulk at low prices with fast, reliable delivery and a helpful contact.

personas.name: Multi-Site Buyer
personas.description: Purchasing lead for a restaurant group opening or restocking sites, moved by scheduled deliveries, repeat ordering and bulk savings.

personas.name: Specialist Operator
personas.description: Pizzeria or Asian restaurant owner struggling to source niche kit affordably, moved by dedicated pizza and Asianware ranges at wholesale prices.

personas.name: Busy Independent
personas.description: Owner-operator of a single cafe, pub or restaurant who values a simple checkout, next-day delivery and a real person to call.

offers: Free next working day delivery on UK mainland orders over £54 inc VAT
Next day delivery on most UK orders placed before 1pm (subject to stock)
Business Trade Accounts with extra discounts and a 30 day credit facility
Split the cost into 3 or 12 monthly payments (Klarna, subject to approval)
Request a personalised quote for large orders

allowed.claim: Free next day delivery on UK mainland orders over £54 inc VAT
Wholesale supplier for caterings, restaurants and commercial kitchens across the UK, founded in 2017
Specialist pizza making equipment and Asian dinnerware at wholesale prices
Klarna instalments and Trade Accounts with a 30 day credit facility available

banned.claim: The best / cheapest / #1 kitchenware supplier in the world
banned.why: FTC substantiation - unqualified superlative that cannot be proven

banned.claim: Guaranteed lowest prices anywhere or you will always save
Inflated review counts or star ratings beyond the actual 4.7/5 from 302 reviews
banned.why: FTC - invented review counts and endorsements are prohibited

banned.claim: Only X units left / countdown timers implying stock is running out when it is not
Next day delivery guaranteed on every order
banned.why: FTC substantiation - real terms are subject to stock, cut-off times and mainland-only, so an unqualified guarantee is unprovable

banned.claim: Eco-friendly or sustainable kitchenware without qualification
banned.why: FTC Green Guides - no substantiation for sustainability claims exists on site
